svg.text: Left cheek, outside face, 1:2.5 (right: mirror). Blue: rail rebates 10 x 50 x 2 deep, inside face. Tan: floor dado 6 deep, inside. Red: Ø4.5 through, Ø8 x 4 counterbore outside.
Floor: birch ply 12, 1235.2 x 517.0: 30 inlet slots 100 x 10 in 3 rows at 468, 483, 498 from its back edge, mesh underneath
Arm-rest: walnut 44 x 76, length 1223.2, between the cheeks, front top edge R10
Plenum rear wall: walnut 12, 1223.2 x 80.0: NC7MD-LX (Ø24 + 2 x Ø3.2) at x 610.3, mid-height; the console's rear panel
Plenum cap strip: walnut 10 x 14, length 1223.2, on the rear wall; the 21 mm channel in front of it is the open outlet (0.026 m2)
Under the floor: open front and back between the cheeks (no base panel): the inlet air comes in there; felt pads under the cheeks
Supply cable: from the NC7MD-LX through back-rail vent slot 14 (30 x 25) and along the floor to the master's J1
Dimensions in mm, from the 3D model's geometry (tools/panel_layout.py). Joints: dowels / screws and glue, from outside through the cheeks.
